text: Yes, the Automatic Curling Iron is a portable rechargeable hair curler [S1]. However, reviewers consistently state that the battery life is terrible and does not last very long, with one noting it only lasts about 20 minutes [S1, S4, S5]. Additionally, the device will not work while plugged in if the battery is running low [S1], and another reviewer mentions the charging cord is not long enough to use while charging [S4].
